properties.name: server.port
properties.description: Netty server HTTP port.

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Context path of the application.

properties.name: server.http.max-content-length
properties.description: Max content length of an HTTP request in bytes.

properties.name: server.http.timeout
properties.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: server.http.max-pipelined-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of same-connection requests queued while a response is in flight (HTTP/1.1 pipelining). 16 by default; 0 or negative means unlimited. Reaching the limit pauses reads (autoRead=false) instead of closing the connection or rejecting requests, because pipelining requires in-order responses; unread bytes stay in the socket buffer, so TCP flow control provides backpressure.

properties.name: server.http.max-ranges
properties.description: Maximum number of byte ranges served as multipart/byteranges. Effective cap is min(value, 100): the underlying parser (Spring HttpRange) rejects more than 100 ranges, which the framework treats as an unusable Range header. Use it to tighten the limit (e.g. 2); values above 100 do not raise it. 0 disables multi-range; negative applies no extra limit. Above the cap the full entity is returned (Range ignored per RFC 9110 14.2).

properties.name: server.check-on-startup
properties.description: Check handler mappings on startup.

properties.name: spring.mvc.async.request-timeout
properties.description: Async request (DeferredResult/Callable) timeout. Supports 30s/1m/1h or plain number (milliseconds).

properties.name: server.shutdown.grace-period
properties.description: Graceful shutdown max wait time. Supports 30s/1m/1h or plain number (milliseconds).

properties.name: server.netty.transport
properties.description: Netty transport type: auto (default, use native epoll on Linux, fallback to NIO), nio (force Java NIO), epoll (force native epoll, fail on unsupported platform).

properties.name: pool.core-pool-size
properties.description: Default business thread pool core pool size.

properties.name: pool.max-pool-size
properties.description: Default business thread pool max pool size.

properties.name: pool.keep-alive-time
properties.description: Business thread pool thread keep-alive time in seconds.

properties.name: pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Default business thread pool queue capacity. Must be bounded so that maxPoolSize takes effect and overload returns 503 instead of queueing unboundedly.

properties.name: server.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections. 0 (default) means unlimited; aligns with Tomcat accept-queue-full rejection semantics.

properties.name: server.max-parameter-count
properties.description: Maximum combined query/form/multipart parameter value count (hash DoS guard). 0 means unlimited; default 10000 aligns with Tomcat/Spring Boot.

properties.name: server.http.multipart.max-part-count
properties.description: Maximum number of parts in a multipart request (file + attribute). -1 (default) means unlimited; hash DoS guard. Semantics align with Spring Boot server.tomcat.max-part-count.

properties.name: server.http.multipart.max-part-header-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single multipart part's header region (header DoS guard). 8192 (default) means limit; <=0 means unlimited. Semantics align with Spring Boot server.tomcat.max-part-header-size.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.enabled
properties.description: Whether multipart (file upload) parsing is enabled.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum size of a single uploaded file (DataSize, e.g. 10MB). -1 (default) means unlimited. Exceeding it returns 413.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the whole multipart request (DataSize, e.g. 10MB). -1 (default) falls back to server.http.max-content-length.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.file-size-threshold
properties.description: Size threshold above which a multipart part is written to disk (DataSize, e.g. 1MB); parts below it stay in memory. -1 (default) keeps the framework default of 16KB; 0 aligns with Boot's write-everything-to-disk semantics.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.location
properties.description: Directory for multipart temp files (used when a part exceeds file-size-threshold). Empty (default) falls back to java.io.tmpdir. Recommended for containers with size-limited tmpfs.

properties.name: spring.web.resources.add-mappings
properties.description: Whether to auto-register the default static resource mapping (/** -> static-locations) when no user ResourceHandlerRegistration exists. Default false (historical behavior: static resources registered by user code).

properties.name: spring.web.resources.static-locations
properties.description: Comma-separated default static resource locations (used by the auto-registered mapping). Default aligns with Spring Boot: classpath:/META-INF/resources/,classpath:/resources/,classpath:/static/,classpath:/public/

properties.name: spring.web.resources.cache.period
properties.description: Default cache period for the auto-registered static resource mapping (Duration or seconds). Unset by default.

properties.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.max-age
properties.description: Default Cache-Control max-age for the auto-registered static resource mapping (takes precedence over cache.period).

properties.name: server.compression.enabled
properties.description: Enable gzip response compression. Off by default; aligns with Spring Boot server.compression.enabled.

properties.name: server.compression.mime-types
properties.description: Comma-separated Content-Type whitelist that participates in compression. Aligns with Spring Boot server.compression.mime-types.

properties.name: server.compression.excluded-user-agents
properties.description: Comma-separated User-Agent regex list; a matching client is served uncompressed. Aligns with Spring Boot server.compression.excluded-user-agents.

properties.name: server.compression.min-response-size
properties.description: Responses smaller than this size (DataSize, default 2KB) are not compressed. Aligns with Spring Boot server.compression.min-response-size.

properties.name: server.address
properties.description: Network interface / IP to bind. Empty means all interfaces (0.0.0.0). Aligns with Spring Boot server.address.

properties.name: server.max-http-request-header-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes of the combined request headers (default 8KB). Aligns with Spring Boot server.max-http-request-header-size.

properties.name: server.max-swallow-size
properties.description: Maximum number of request-body bytes to swallow after an error response (default 2MB; negative means unlimited). Aligns with Spring Boot server.max-swallow-size.

properties.name: server.max-http-response-header-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes of the response headers (default 8KB); exceeding it degrades to a minimal 500. Aligns with Spring Boot server.max-http-response-header-size.

properties.name: server.keep-alive-timeout
properties.description: Idle timeout (millis; Duration style supported) after which a keep-alive connection is closed.

properties.name: server.max-keep-alive-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of requests served on a single keep-alive connection before it is closed.

properties.name: server.forward-headers-strategy
properties.description: Whether to honor forwarded headers: NONE/FALSE (do not trust), FRAMEWORK/NATIVE (trust Forwarded / X-Forwarded-*). Aligns with Spring Boot server.forward-headers-strategy.

properties.name: server.http2.enabled
properties.description: Enable HTTP/2 support (requires TLS/ALPN for browser clients).

properties.name: server.http.read-timeout
properties.description: HTTP read timeout in millis (Duration style such as 30s supported).

properties.name: server.http.max-initial-line-length
properties.description: Maximum length in bytes of the HTTP request initial line (default 4KB).

properties.name: server.http.max-chunk-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes of each HTTP chunk (default 8KB).

properties.name: server.http.max-in-memory-size
properties.description: Max request-body bytes kept in memory before switching to a ByteBuf duplicate (default 4KB).

properties.name: server.netty.workers
properties.description: Number of Netty worker event-loop threads (default: 2 x CPU cores).

properties.name: server.netty.boss-threads
properties.description: Number of Netty boss event-loop threads (default 1).

properties.name: server.netty.so-backlog
properties.description: TCP listen backlog (default 1024).

properties.name: server.netty.tcp-nodelay
properties.description: TCP_NODELAY (disable Nagle's algorithm). Default true.

properties.name: server.netty.so-keepalive
properties.description: SO_KEEPALIVE for accepted connections. Default true.

properties.name: server.netty.so-reuseaddr
properties.description: SO_REUSEADDR for the server channel. Default true.

properties.name: server.netty.allocator-type
properties.description: ByteBuf allocator type: pooled (default) or unpooled.

properties.name: server.netty.write-buffer-low-watermark
properties.description: Channel write-buffer low watermark in bytes (default 8KB).

properties.name: server.netty.write-buffer-high-watermark
properties.description: Channel write-buffer high watermark in bytes (default 32KB); crossing it marks the channel non-writable for backpressure.

properties.name: server.servlet.application-display-name
properties.description: ServletContext application display name. Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.application-display-name.

properties.name: server.servlet.encoding.charset
properties.description: Unified request/response character set. Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.encoding.charset.

properties.name: server.servlet.encoding.force
properties.description: Force the configured charset on both request and response, overriding any explicit setCharacterEncoding. Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.encoding.force.

properties.name: server.servlet.encoding.force-request
properties.description: Force the configured charset on the request (inherits force when unset). Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.encoding.force-request.

properties.name: server.servlet.encoding.force-response
properties.description: Force the configured charset on the response (inherits force when unset). Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.encoding.force-response.

properties.name: server.servlet.session.tracking-modes
properties.description: Comma-separated session tracking modes: COOKIE (default) / URL (SSL is N/A for this framework). Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.session.tracking-modes.

properties.name: server.servlet.session.persistent
properties.description: Persist sessions to disk so they survive a restart (JDK serialization, one file per session). Default false. Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.session.persistent.

properties.name: server.servlet.session.store-dir
properties.description: Directory for persisted sessions (used when session.persistent=true). Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.session.store-dir.

properties.name: server.servlet.session.persistent-exclude
properties.description: Comma-separated session attribute names excluded from disk persistence.

properties.name: server.servlet.session.persistent-deserialization-filter
properties.description: ObjectInputFilter spec (semicolon-separated, e.g. java.util.*;io.springperf.web.*;!*) applied when reading persisted session files. Omitted means no filtering, which is the historical behaviour; when set, only matching classes load and a rejected file is discarded like any corrupt one. This key has no Spring Boot counterpart: Boot 3.5.16 has 13 server.servlet.session.* keys and none of them is about deserialization filtering.

properties.name: server.servlet.virtual-server-name
properties.description: ServletContext virtual server name. Aligns with Spring Boot server.servlet.virtual-server-name.

properties.name: server.error.include-stacktrace
properties.description: When to expose a stack trace in error responses: never (default) / on-param / always. Aligns with Spring Boot server.error.include-stacktrace.

properties.name: server.error.include-message
properties.description: When to expose the exception message in error responses: never (default) / on-param / always. Aligns with Spring Boot server.error.include-message.

properties.name: server.error.include-binding-errors
properties.description: When to expose binding/validation errors: never (default) / always. Aligns with Spring Boot server.error.include-binding-errors.

properties.name: server.error.whitelabel.enabled
properties.description: Whether to render the built-in whitelabel HTML error page. Aligns with Spring Boot server.error.whitelabel.enabled.

properties.name: server.error.path
properties.description: Error page path / instance identifier. Aligns with Spring Boot server.error.path.

properties.name: server.accesslog.enabled
properties.description: Enable the access-log filter. Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.enabled (this framework keeps a container-agnostic server.accesslog.* prefix).

properties.name: server.accesslog.format
properties.description: Access-log format supporting %h/%m/%U/%T/%s/%u placeholders. Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.pattern.

properties.name: server.accesslog.directory
properties.description: Directory for access-log files; when unset the filter only logs via SLF4J. Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.directory.

properties.name: server.accesslog.prefix
properties.description: Access-log file name prefix. Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.prefix.

properties.name: server.accesslog.suffix
properties.description: Access-log file name suffix. Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.suffix.

properties.name: server.accesslog.rotate
properties.description: Rotate access-log files daily (date appended to the file name). Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.rotate.

properties.name: server.accesslog.max-days
properties.description: Number of days to retain rotated access-log files (<=0 means unlimited). Aligns with Spring Boot server.tomcat.accesslog.max-days.

properties.name: pool.default-execute-mode
properties.description: Default business-pool execute mode for request handling.

properties.name: spring.mvc.throw-exception-if-no-handler-found
properties.description: Whether a missing handler raises an exception (routable to @ControllerAdvice) instead of a direct 404/405. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.throw-exception-if-no-handler-found.

properties.name: spring.mvc.dispatch.error
properties.description: Whether ERROR requests are dispatched to handlers. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.dispatch.error.

properties.name: spring.mvc.dispatch.options
properties.description: Whether OPTIONS requests are dispatched to handlers (CORS preflight is still handled when disabled). Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.dispatch.options.

properties.name: spring.mvc.dispatch.trace
properties.description: Whether TRACE requests are dispatched to handlers. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.dispatch.trace.

properties.name: spring.mvc.publish-request-handled-events
properties.description: Whether to publish a ServletRequestHandledEvent when a request completes. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.publish-request-handled-events.

properties.name: spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled
properties.description: Render error responses as RFC 7807 application/problem+json. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled.

properties.name: spring.mvc.message-codes-resolver-format
properties.description: Validation message-code format: prefix_error_code (default) or postfix_error_code. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.message-codes-resolver-format.

properties.name: spring.mvc.static-path-pattern
properties.description: Global prefix applied to all resource handler path patterns (default /** means no prefix). Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.static-path-pattern.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.date
properties.description: Default date format used when no @DateTimeFormat is present. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.format.date.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.time
properties.description: Default time format used when no @DateTimeFormat is present. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.format.time.

properties.name: spring.mvc.format.datetime
properties.description: Default date-time format used when no @DateTimeFormat is present. Aligns with Spring Boot spring.mvc.format.datetime.

properties.name: spring.web.locale
properties.description: Default Locale (e.g. zh_CN). Aligns with Spring Boot spring.web.locale.

properties.name: spring.web.locale-resolver
properties.description: Locale resolution strategy: fixed or accept-header (default). Aligns with Spring Boot spring.web.locale-resolver.

properties.name: spring.web.locale-bind
properties.description: Whether to bind LocaleContextHolder per request (default true, aligned with Spring MVC). Setting false removes the per-request locale context allocation and the ThreadLocal set/remove; LocaleContextHolder.getLocaleContext() then returns null and getLocale() falls back to Locale.getDefault().

properties.name: spring.mvc.view.prefix
properties.description: Prefix for JSP views only (aligns with Boot's InternalResourceViewResolver semantics). Template engines use their own spring.{engine}.prefix. Default /jsp/ preserves the framework's historical default.

properties.name: spring.mvc.view.suffix
properties.description: Suffix for JSP views only. Default .jsp preserves the framework's historical default.
